videos.video_title: Sheet Metal Fabrication & Stainless Steel Welding — Career Journey of a Welder Fabricator
videos.description: Meet Rajesh, a certified Stainless Steel Fabricator in Pune. He explains his journey from ITI Welder trade, learning TIG/MIG arc welding, sheet metal cutting, and growing to senior shop supervisor.
videos.relevance_reason: Firsthand career journey from ITI to certified Stainless Steel Fabricator with practical workshop demonstration.
videos.source_query: How I became a Stainless Steel Fabricator India

videos.video_title: Stainless Steel Fabrication for Beginners — Tools, Machine Safety & Basic Layout
videos.description: Essential beginner guide for anyone starting in fabrication: understanding stainless steel gauges, plasma cutting basics, bending brakes, and personal protective equipment.
videos.relevance_reason: Beginner-friendly overview of fabrication tools, raw materials, and workshop safety protocols.
videos.source_query: Stainless Steel Fabricator for beginners India

videos.video_title: TIG Welding Stainless Steel — Hands-on Workshop Practical Skills Demonstration
videos.description: Practical welding demonstration on SS-304 sheets. Shows heat control, argon gas shielding, purge welding techniques, and weld cleaning to avoid oxidation.
videos.relevance_reason: Detailed demonstration of core competencies: TIG welding, sheet metal jointing, and defect prevention.
videos.source_query: Stainless Steel Fabricator practical training and tools

videos.video_title: Fabricator Apprenticeship to Factory Supervisor — Career Growth & Salary Insights
videos.description: Detailed interview with an experienced fabrication supervisor in Haryana discussing apprentice stipends, shift realities, ESIC/PF benefits, and career promotion pathways.
videos.relevance_reason: Authentic discussion on apprenticeship transition, entry-level wages, and long-term career growth in capital goods.

videos.video_title: Day in the Life of an Instrumentation Technician in an Indian Process Plant
videos.description: Follow Amit, an instrumentation technician in a fertilizer plant. See how he calibrates temperature sensors, checks 4-20mA current loops, and maintains pressure transmitters.
videos.relevance_reason: Real day-in-the-life walkthrough of process control calibration, sensor maintenance, and plant shifts.

videos.video_title: Instrumentation Basics for Beginners — Sensors, Transmitters & Control Loops
videos.description: Clear foundational video on what process instrumentation technicians do: RTDs, thermocouples, digital multimeters, and reading P&ID schematics.
videos.relevance_reason: Covers essential introductory concepts: sensors, transmitters, and loop calibration for beginners.

videos.video_title: Transmitter Calibration Hands-on Practical Training — Hart Communicator Tutorial
videos.description: Step-by-step practical session using a 475 Field Communicator to calibrate a differential pressure transmitter on a live bench test station.
videos.relevance_reason: Practical hands-on training with industry-standard Hart Communicator calibration equipment.
videos.source_query: Instrumentation Technician practical training and tools

videos.video_title: From Diploma Apprentice to Lead Instrumentation Engineer — Career Roadmap
videos.description: Insights on apprenticeship stipends, petrochemical industry opportunities, PLC/SCADA upskilling, and Gulf employment pathways for Indian technicians.
videos.relevance_reason: Explains vocational progression from apprentice to senior DCS/PLC operator and petrochemical jobs.

videos.video_title: ITI Fitter Trade se Senior Machine Assembler tak ka Safar — Real Journey
videos.description: Sunil Kumar shares his journey: clearing 10th standard, joining ITI Fitter trade, 1-year apprenticeship at an auto ancillaries plant, and becoming a full-time machine assembler.
videos.relevance_reason: Authentic Hindi career journey from 10th pass to ITI Fitter certificate and auto manufacturing job.
videos.source_query: Mechanical Fitter ITI career journey Hindi

videos.video_title: Mechanical Fitter Trade Explained — Syllabus, Tools & Machine Shop Work
videos.description: Comprehensive explanation of what a mechanical fitter does: bench work, filing, scraping, drilling, lathe turning basics, and precision assembly.
videos.relevance_reason: Clear introduction to fitter trade curriculum, tools, and hands-on mechanical assembly tasks.

videos.video_title: Precision Measurement & Assembly — Micrometer & Vernier Caliper Workshop Demo
videos.description: Hands-on demonstration on measuring tolerances within 0.02mm using vernier calipers, outside micrometers, and dial test indicators during gearbox fitting.
videos.relevance_reason: Practical measurement demonstration of core mechanical fitting competencies and tolerances.

videos.video_title: Railway Apprentice vs Private Industry Fitter — Career Pathways & Growth
videos.description: Detailed comparison of Apprentice Act training in Indian Railways, defense ordnance factories, vs private manufacturing plants, including career ladders.
videos.relevance_reason: Objective comparison of public railway apprenticeship vs private factory employment ladders.

videos.video_title: Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW/MMAW) — Beginner to Professional Welder Journey
videos.description: Real welder story from an industrial fabrication shop in Gujarat. Explains arc striking, electrode selection (E6013 vs E7018), and progression from helper to certified 6G pipe welder.
videos.relevance_reason: Firsthand journey from welding apprentice helper to certified structural SMAW welder.
videos.source_query: Manual Metal Arc Welding career journey India

videos.video_title: Manual Metal Arc Welding for Beginners — Electrode Angles, Current & Safety
videos.description: Foundational guide covering welding transformers, polarity, travel speed, arc length control, and auto-darkening helmet safety.
videos.relevance_reason: Essential SMAW/MMAW basics: setting amperage, electrode rod manipulation, and slag removal.
videos.source_query: Manual Metal Arc Welding for beginners

videos.video_title: Fillet Weld in 1F and 2F Positions — Workshop Practical Demonstration
videos.description: Demonstration on 10mm mild steel plates. Shows arc initiation, weaving techniques, maintaining bead uniformity, and visual inspection for undercut.
videos.relevance_reason: Hands-on workshop demonstration of fillet joints and structural welding standards.
videos.source_query: Shielded Metal Arc Welding workshop practical demonstration

videos.video_title: Welder Apprenticeship in Heavy Industries — Daily Routine, Risks & Growth
videos.description: Interview with a boiler fabrication plant welder in Trichy detailing work conditions, heat stress management, boiler code certifications, and export fabrication salaries.
videos.relevance_reason: Insights into boiler fabrication apprenticeships, workplace safety, and career earnings.

videos.video_title: Sheet Metal Worker ITI Trade Career Journey — From Training to Auto Body Shop
videos.description: Ramesh explains his journey through DGT Sheet Metal Worker curriculum, learning sheet shearing, press brake forming, ducting fabrication, and working in car chassis production.
videos.relevance_reason: Direct career pathway from ITI Sheet Metal Trade to automotive manufacturing line.
videos.source_query: Sheet metal worker career journey India

videos.video_title: Sheet Metal Work for Beginners — Hand Shears, Stakes & Pattern Development
videos.description: Introduction to sheet metal tools: snips, mallets, folding bars, layout geometric pattern drafting (radial line & parallel line development).
videos.relevance_reason: Foundational guide on pattern drafting, hand shearing, and sheet metal layout.

videos.video_title: HVAC Ducting & Bending Machine Practical Demo — Sheet Metal Workshop
videos.description: Step-by-step practical session on building rectangular galvanized iron (GI) ducting, Pittsburgh seams, and hydraulic bending operations.
videos.relevance_reason: Practical hands-on workshop training on seam joints, ducting fabrication, and sheet benders.
videos.source_query: Sheet metal practical training and tools used

videos.video_title: Sheet Metal Worker Job Roles — Ducting, Roofing & Automotive Fabrication
videos.description: Overview of employment avenues across industrial roofing, HVAC duct fabrication, and auto component stamping with realistic entry wages.
videos.relevance_reason: Explains market demand, contractor opportunities, and salary progression across sectors.

videos.video_title: CNC Machine Operator Career Scope, ITI Apprenticeship & Factory Work Life
videos.description: Follow a CNC VMC operator in an automotive parts manufacturing unit in Chennai. Learn G-code basics, tooling offsets, and career growth.
videos.relevance_reason: Real factory workshop footage, job role responsibilities, and progression to CNC Programmer.

videos.video_title: CNC Turning & Milling Setup for Beginners - G-Codes & Work Offsets
videos.description: Learn CNC coordinates, work coordinate setting (G54), tool length compensation (G43), and safe cycle execution.
videos.relevance_reason: Essential machine setup, zero setting, and safety interlocks for beginners.

videos.video_title: From ITI Electrician to Industrial Plant Maintenance Engineer - Journey & Skills
videos.description: Meet Sunil, an industrial electrician working with 3-phase motor control panels, PLC wiring, safety breakers, and preventive maintenance.
videos.relevance_reason: Practical explanation of control wiring, maintenance safety standards, and career promotions.
